title: EtaleInjectiveSectionsComparison
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point, $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{et}}))$, $n\in\mathbf Z$, and $Q$ the strict-local neighbourhood geometry of [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry]. Write $D_i$ for its stage, $t_i:D_i\to X$ for its projection, and $p:X\times_S S_{(s)}\to X$ for the limit projection. Let $J$ be a bounded-below complex of injective abelian sheaves, and $q:K\cong QJ$ a specified isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative]. For any $g:Y\to X$, put $B_g=H^n(Q\Gamma_Y(g^{-1}J))$, using termwise inverse image and termwise sections. Define $c_g:B_g\to H^n(Y,g^{-1}K)$ by the right-derived sections unit $Q\Gamma_Y(g^{-1}J)\to R\Gamma_Y(Qg^{-1}J)$ followed by the inverse-image localization comparison and $g^{-1}q^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image]. For a triangle $h=a\circ g$, let $r_{a,g,h}:B_g\to B_h$ be homology of termwise sections restriction: the inverse-image adjunction unit followed by the underived Leray comparison and the inverse inverse-image composition isomorphism. Then each $c_{t_i}$ is invertible. If $a:i\to j$ is a neighbourhood morphism, $c_{t_j}$ followed by the canonical derived cohomology pullback along $D(a)$ equals $r_{D(a),t_j,t_i}$ followed by $c_{t_i}$. For each cone leg $Q_i$, $c_{t_i}$ followed by canonical derived cohomology pullback along $Q_i$ equals $r_{Q_i,t_i,p}$ followed by $c_p$. The canonical derived pullback is the derived adjunction unit, Leray comparison, and inverse-image composition comparison of [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-mate-projection-data]. No invertibility of $c_p$ is asserted.

proof.text: Each stage projection is etale by base change. Etale inverse image is localization restriction; the exact extension-by-zero left adjoint and the right-adjoint-preserves-injectives theorem show that the restricted complex J has injective terms. It is bounded below, hence K-injective.
The right-derived sections unit is invertible on each restricted injective complex. The localization comparisons and q are isomorphisms, so their homology composite c_t is invertible.

For each transition and each cone leg, apply naturality of the right-derived sections unit to the termwise inverse-image unit and sections restriction. The derived adjunction unit and Leray comparison are the derived images of these maps. Transport inverse-image composition through localization and q; the resulting square is c_g followed by derived pullback equals r followed by c_h. At the limit retain the comparison unit rather than an inverse, so no injective-preservation claim for the limit projection is used.

theorem injectiveSections_strictLocal_comparison {X S : Scheme.{v}}
    (f : X ⟶ S)
    {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (n : ℤ) (Q : StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry f s)
    (J : CochainComplex.Plus (InjectiveObject
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})))
    (q : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj)) :
    (∀ i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
      IsIso (representativeSectionsComparison
        ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i) q n)) ∧
    (∀ {i j : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)} (a : i ⟶ j),
      representativeSectionsComparison
        ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app j) q n ≫
      (Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).obj j) n).map
        ((Etale.mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
          ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).map a)).unit.app
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app
        j)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              K.obj)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} n).map
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
          AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).map a)).hom.app
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).map
        a)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f
        s).app j)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                K.obj))) ≫
      (Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).obj i) n).map
        ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
          (Etale.upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).map a)
        ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app j)
            ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i) ((Category.comp_id
        ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i)).symm.trans
        ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).naturality a).symm)) ≪≫
          Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
            (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app j))
            (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).map
        a))).inv.app K.obj) =
        termwiseSectionsRestriction ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).map a)
          ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app j)
          ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i)
          ((Category.comp_id _).symm.trans
            ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).naturality a).symm)
          (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj) n ≫
        representativeSectionsComparison
          ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i) q n) ∧
    (∀ i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
      representativeSectionsComparison
        ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i) q n ≫
      (Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).obj i) n).map
        ((Etale.mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
          (Q.legs.app i)).unit.app
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app
        i)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              K.obj)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} n).map
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
          AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Q.legs.app i)).hom.app
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Q.legs.app i)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f
        s).app i)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                K.obj))) ≫
      (Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (pullback f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap
        s)) n).map
        ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
          (Etale.upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Q.legs.app i)
        ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i) (pullback.fst f
        (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))
            (Q.over i).symm) ≪≫
          Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
            (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i))
            (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Q.legs.app i))).inv.app K.obj) =
        termwiseSectionsRestriction (Q.legs.app i)
          ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i)
          (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))
          (Q.over i).symm
          (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj) n ≫
        representativeSectionsComparison
          (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) q n)
